correctness.rationale: For v(u²−4v)(1+u+v)≠0, the rational map w=4x²/(x²+1)² shows the degree-ten hyperelliptic defining polynomial is squarefree and genus four. Quotients under two commuting x↦−x involutions are isomorphic smooth genus-two curves with prime-to-five Jacobian-square isogeny. In characteristic five the genus-two Cartier coefficient matrix is [[A,4ab],[2,D]], A=a²+2ab+2b, D=2a+1, with P=AD−8ab. Rank is 2 when P≠0 and 1 when P=0; rank-one semilinear square vanishes iff A^5+D=0. Writing P=L(a)b+K(a), L=2−a²−2a, K=a²(2a+1), substitution gives H(a) of degree15. Its roots avoid smoothness exclusions and are simple; H=(a+1)J with irreducible degree14 factor J. Independently computed sympy GF5 gcd(H,H′)=1 and factor degrees [1,14] (both multiplicity one); RESULT.md and verify.py supply exact polynomial identities, Rabin irreducibility conditions, F5/F25 point-count checks. The genus-two p-rank/Newton cases 2/1/0 double to genus four 4/2/0 and a-number 0/2/2 by prime-to-five isogeny. Finite checks do not replace the geometric argument.
